notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1786). Words follow the engraving's spelling (quì, stà, sà, litè for lite, sara for sarà, vo', schiviam, veggiamo). IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions joined with ‿ only where the score sets two words on one note, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ, intervocalic s voiced; precipizio is sung as five syllables once (pre-ci-pi-zi-o). Translation literal, for meaning.
